## Language change
Describe vocabulary, grammar, script, teaching material or tooling being changed.

## Evidence
- [ ] The 26 original native glyphs and 16 obligatory written resonance markers remain compatible
- [ ] New words have a precise definition, IPA, usage example and part of speech
- [ ] Novel idioms are labelled *editorial* until independent review
- [ ] No human recording or dialect claim is published without consent and provenance
- [ ] Grammar changes have a positive sentence and a minimally different negative example
- [ ] Relevant tests pass

## Review
List the exact file/rule affected, reviewer decisions, licensing, and any known semantic ambiguity.
